name: Overland Park Open 2017

venue.name: Aubry Bend Middle School
venue.details: In the cafeteria, please follow the signs

information:
* Registration is $15 for the "core events"(2x2, 3x3, 4x4, and skewb) and $20 for all events
* Competitor limit is 60
* Spectators are free, but try not to have more than 2 or 3
* 3x3 w/ feet is difficult to organize and run, SERIOUS COMPETITORS ONLY PLEASE
* The competitors and timers will be on a stage, which is about 4ft(1m) above the ground
* Please do not wander around the building
* A guest WiFi network will be available to the public for use during the competition
